name: PresentTall
shape_prompt: Stylized 3D game prop, chunky vinyl-toy style, smooth sculpted rounded forms, quirky proportions. A tall wrapped Christmas present box, twice as tall as wide, puffy rounded edges, a ribbon crossing over the top and down every side, and a floppy bow with long curly tails on top. Single object, no base.
texture_prompt: Bright saturated colours, smooth soft vinyl-toy finish, clean hand-painted look. Bright teal wrapping paper with white candy-cane stripes, pink ribbon and bow. No text, no logos.

assemble._note: placePresent scales by the Box's largest side, so the size here only sets proportions.
